description: This PHP script interfaces with the Redmine issue tracker API. It demonstrates how to initialize the API client, retrieve an issue by ID, output issue details, create a new issue via XML, and send it to Redmine.

classes.name: redmine
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with Redmine's REST API, including retrieving issues and creating new issues.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves a specific issue from Redmine given its ID.

methods.name: addIssueFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Redmine using a SimpleXMLElement representing the issue data.
